An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 16 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. The deposit is 74 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
